name: print-social-first-communion-posts-peach-and-maroon-with-leaf-sprigs
title: First Communion pack in peach, coral and maroon with leaf-sprig illustrations
whatItIs: Nine square posts in peach with coral and maroon blocks, photos of children praying and a priest with a chalice, serif uppercase 'MY FIRST COMMUNION' and 'Eucharist' titles, thin line leaf sprigs and a flame logo.
whatItMeans: Warm and reverent; soft peach and botanical lines feel gentle for a child's milestone.
techniques: Layer coral and maroon blocks under text.
Use an offset line frame around photos.

vocabulary.definition: A small illustrated branch of leaves.
